# Hawzy's Kitchen & Recipe Blog

> An agentic family recipe catalog, weekly dinner planning engine, and grocery fulfillment platform.

## Machine Endpoints
- [Active Weekly Menu JSON]({{ '/api/weekly-menu.json' | absolute_url }}): Scaled weekly menu, scheduled meals, kitchen-testing status, and ingredient manifests.
- [All Recipes JSON]({{ '/api/recipes.json' | absolute_url }}): Complete catalog of structured recipe objects including `status` (`untested` / `tested`), `origin`, `tested_on`, and `sources`.
